note: INT-528. The read-only credential check the go-live runbook runs first: Netgsm's sender-name listing (section 'Gönderici Adı Sorgulama', REST v2) answers with the account's approved sender names, or code 30 when the usercode or password is wrong, the sub-user has no API permission, or the request comes from an address outside the account's IP restriction. Every shape is copied from the public documentation; nothing was captured from a live call. The error sample's code is the literal 'XX' in the documentation; the documented codes are 30, 70 and 100-101.

endpoint.auth: http-basic: usercode (the subscriber number) and the API sub-user's password

documented_error_codes.30: credentials, API permission or IP restriction
